description: MonitorBankRates national or state average rates (APY for deposits, APR for loans) computed daily from every published rate across 8,000+ banks and credit unions. Returns the latest value, change over 1 week / 1 month / 3 months, institution and quote counts, and a daily history. Good for "what are CD rates doing", "average mortgage rate in Texas", "average refinance rate", "are savings rates falling".

keys.description: One or more rate keys (see list_rate_keys), e.g. ["12-month","60-month"], ["30-year"] or ["refinance-30-year"].

state.description: Optional two-letter state code or name. Omit for the national average.

name: get_average_rates
title: Average rates and trends
